{{Top|leg}}
A '''duplex circuit''' was a integral component of a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]]. If removed, it prevented the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] from working. If replaced with a [[triplex circuit]], the diagnostics would register that there was no problem with the shield system. However, when activated, the shields would not raise. This problem could be fixed with a [[codepatch]].
